data.title: 橘美花莉 · 社团教室的摄影指导
data.description: 放学后的漫研教室里，美花莉身穿黑色开襟西装的高中制服站在黑板前，利用自己作为现役人气模特的专业经验，认真向奥村示范如何在不同打光角度下寻找最上镜的身体线条。她抬手轻抚发梢，栗棕长发的两侧束发与粉色缎带轻晃，粉色眼眸中满是渴望被心上人多注视一眼的自信与期待。
data.action: 在黑板前单手叉腰示范模特站姿与受光角度，粉眸含笑凝视镜头
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana demonstrates a camera-friendly pose to Okumura before the manga clubroom's blackboard, lifting one hand to brush her chestnut hair. Her open black school blazer, beige vest and red bow stay precise above the grey skirt; pink side ribbons swing lightly. The medium view includes the desks where he watches. Sunset from the windows lights her raised wrist and hair edges, with softer shadows across the board behind her expectant pink eyes.
